title: The Robbers' Barrow
objective: Find what the grave robber has gathered in the old barrow, and get out alive. Leave by the way you came in when you are ready.

rooms.name: Barrow Mouth
rooms.description: A low doorway of fitted stones opens onto the hillside. Daylight reaches a few steps in and no further.

features.name: Scratched Lintel
features.description: The stone over the doorway is scored with fresh knife marks.
features.discovery: Someone has scratched a warning into the stone: "Robber on the bier. Silver underneath."

rooms.name: Burial Hall
rooms.description: A long, low hall of packed earth and old bones. A stone bier stands at the far end under a rotted cloth, and a lumpy sack lies beside it.

features.name: Stone Bier
features.description: A waist-high slab of grey stone, draped in cloth gone black with age.
features.discovery: Beneath the rotted cloth lies a neck ring of twisted silver, and a dark red stone has rolled into a crack in the slab.

features.name: Robber's Sack
features.description: A patched grain sack, knotted at the neck and heavy for its size.
features.discovery: The sack holds the robber's haul from the older graves: a fistful of tarnished gold coins.

items.name: Silver Torc
items.description: A neck ring of twisted silver, heavy and cold.

items.name: Grave Garnet
items.description: A polished garnet the size of a thumbnail, dark as old wine.

items.name: Grave Gold
items.description: Fifty old gold coins, worn smooth and stamped with a forgotten king.

items.name: Grave Robber's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

passages.description: A short passage slopes down into the dark.

opponents.name: Grave Robber
opponents.description: A wiry robber crouches on the bier, picking through the grave goods, and leaps down with a scimitar drawn.

endings.title: Out with the silver
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight with the barrow's treasure heavy in your pack.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight with nothing to show for the barrow but dust.

endings.title: Fallen in the barrow
endings.text: You fall among the old bones. Your adventuring ends here.
